verdict.rationale: Modal ships an official CLI that can be installed standalone, plus a Python SDK for programmatic interaction with the platform. Both are first-party, non-interactive surfaces suited to headless automation. However, no evidence explicitly documents CI usage, such as non-interactive token authentication, environment-variable credentials, or CI pipeline examples. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions deploy guide), headless token/credential auth for CI, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The CLI can also be installed as a standalone tool via [uvx.sh](https://uvx.sh):
The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
The JS and Go SDKs allow you to use Modal Sandboxes, invoke deployed Modal Functions, and interact with some Modal platform resources.
